children: Australian shares were likely to open higher on Monday, helped by potential gains in heavyweight miners on steady iron ore pricing, while broader strength could be tempered by losses in gold stocks as bullion prices remained weak.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) rose 0.2%, a 15.2-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark fell 0.5% on Friday.
